matrix_label: M5 artifact-provenance-bundle card and attestation/SBOM status-row primitive: artifact identity, digest set, signature state, attestation state, SBOM/notice bundle state, digest lineage, inventory format/scope/freshness/export, mirror refs, and compare/export truth

provenance_rows.scope_summary: The release-center provenance card renders the shared provenance-bundle primitive so a signed-and-verified artifact with a verified attestation, a pinned immutable digest, and a full SBOM reads as trust-proven-exact with an intact compare/export binding, while an artifact whose signature is present but does not verify reads as blocked-signature-broken with a self-contained banner naming the reason, the bound digest, its mirror refs, and the re-sign-and-verify next action

provenance_banner.headline: Provenance held: the signature is present but does not verify — artifact artifact:aureline-shell 5.2.0 (digest sha256:cc33shell, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture blocked_signature_broken, next: re_sign_and_verify

provenance_rows.scope_summary: The enterprise-evaluation provenance sheet renders the shared primitive so an artifact carrying a verified attestation and a complete SBOM whose signing key is not yet verified reads as narrowed-signature-unverified — the SBOM and attestation presence never elevate it to proven — while an artifact whose immutable-digest lineage is broken reads as blocked-digest-lineage-broken with a rebuild-and-reconcile next action

provenance_banner.headline: Provenance held: the signing key is not verified (inventory presence does not prove trust) — artifact artifact:aureline-graph 5.2.0 (digest sha256:dd44graph, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture narrowed_signature_unverified, next: verify_signing_key

Provenance held: the immutable-digest lineage is broken — artifact artifact:aureline-registry 5.2.0 (digest sha256:ee55registry, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture blocked_digest_lineage_broken, next: rebuild_and_reconcile_digest

provenance_rows.scope_summary: The CLI provenance-inspect surface renders the shared primitive so a signed-and-verified artifact whose clean-room rebuild reproduced the digest but which carries no attestation reads as trust-signed-not-attested — honest that it is not attested rather than overclaiming — while an artifact whose signature, attestation, SBOM, and digest are still being evaluated reads as blocked-provenance-unknown with a run-provenance-verification next action

provenance_banner.headline: Provenance held: the provenance state is not yet evaluated — artifact artifact:aureline-preview 5.3.0 (digest sha256:aa77preview, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture blocked_provenance_unknown, next: run_provenance_verification

provenance_rows.scope_summary: The admin provenance report renders the shared primitive so a signed-and-verified artifact whose attestation is present but not yet verified reads as narrowed-attestation-unverified with a verify-attestation next action, while an unsigned artifact carrying a complete SBOM reads as narrowed-signature-unverified — unsigned provenance is never conflated with signed

provenance_banner.headline: Provenance held: the attestation is present but not verified — artifact artifact:aureline-update 5.2.0 (digest sha256:bb88update, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture narrowed_attestation_unverified, next: verify_attestation

Provenance held: the signing key is not verified (inventory presence does not prove trust) — artifact artifact:aureline-mirror 5.2.0 (digest sha256:cc99mirror, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture narrowed_signature_unverified, next: verify_signing_key

provenance_rows.scope_summary: The support provenance export renders the shared primitive so a signed-and-verified artifact whose SBOM is only partial reads as narrowed-inventory-incomplete with the Partial state preserved and a complete-inventory next action, and a signed-and-verified artifact whose attestation has expired reads as narrowed-attestation-unverified — the same provenance and inventory vocabulary a support or evaluation reviewer reads across every surface

provenance_banner.headline: Provenance held: the inventory is partial or stale — artifact artifact:aureline-support-tools 5.2.0 (digest sha256:dd00support, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture narrowed_inventory_incomplete, next: complete_inventory

Provenance held: the attestation is present but not verified — artifact artifact:aureline-docs 5.2.0 (digest sha256:ee11docs, 1 mirror ref(s)); posture narrowed_attestation_unverified, next: verify_attestation
